Existing adapter blockPoolStorageObtained registers that receiver with the DataStorage actor; blockPoolStorageEnter scopes doTransition. Recalibrate with pinned adapter and verify each target occurrence has dn index/epoch, not just class catalog.
cases.validation_gate: Run a fresh isolated healthy MiniCluster seed with current pinned adapter; require exact target on named dn index and epoch, zero selected throw, and observed-path doors before fault trials. No source-only success claim.
